instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide shot, slightly high angle. In an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls, the man in the black t-shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the right, facing away-left. The woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the left, facing right and smiling happily. They are hugging each other tightly in the center of the room, with the woman resting her head on the man's shoulder and wrapping her arms around his neck. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows.
